title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 16
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 16: Ziba's gifts, Shimei's curses, and Ahithophel's counsel to Absalom.

questions.text: Who met David with saddled donkeys loaded with bread, raisins, summer fruits and wine?
questions.explanation: Ziba the servant of Mephibosheth met him with a couple of donkeys saddled, carrying bread, raisins, summer fruits, and wine.

questions.text: Where did Ziba say his master's son was staying?
questions.explanation: Ziba said, "Behold, he is staying in Jerusalem."

questions.text: What did David give to Ziba?
questions.explanation: The king said to Ziba, "Behold, all that belongs to Mephibosheth is yours."

answers.text: A place at the king's table

questions.text: Who came out at Bahurim and cursed David?
questions.explanation: At Bahurim a man of the family of Saul's house came out, whose name was Shimei, the son of Gera.

questions.text: What did Shimei call David as he cursed him?
questions.explanation: Shimei said, "Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, and wicked fellow!"

questions.text: What did Abishai want to do to Shimei?
questions.explanation: Abishai said, "Why should this dead dog curse my lord the king? Please let me go over and take off his head."

answers.text: Go over and take off his head

questions.text: Besides cursing and throwing stones, what else did Shimei throw at David?
questions.explanation: Shimei cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.

questions.text: What did Hushai say when he came to Absalom?
questions.explanation: Hushai said to Absalom, "Long live the king! Long live the king!"

answers.text: "I have come to spy on you."

questions.text: Where was a tent spread for Absalom when he followed Ahithophel's counsel?
questions.explanation: They spread a tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and he went in to his father's concubines in the sight of all Israel.

answers.text: On the top of the house
By the gate of the city

questions.text: How is the counsel of Ahithophel in those days described?
questions.explanation: The counsel of Ahithophel was as if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God.

answers.text: As if a man inquired at the inner sanctuary of God
As the empty words of a fool in the gate
As the foolish counsel of a young child
As a passing dream in the night season
